chunks: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying:
It is incumbent upon you to supplicate, for you will not draw closer (to Allah) by anything similar to it.
And do not abandon supplicating for a small (matter) due to its smallness. Indeed He who is the Owner of small things is also the Owner of great things.

key_terms.تَقَرَّبُونَ: drawing near to Allah through acts of worship
key_terms.صَاحِبَ الصِّغَارِ: the Owner of small things — affirming Allah's care for every detail of creation
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْكِبَارِ: the Owner of great things — pairing with small things to affirm Allah's universal dominion
key_terms.عَلَيْكُمْ بِالدُّعَاءِ: an imperative urging constant adherence to supplication

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the importance of supplicating for small matters?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) exhorts his companions to make du'a a constant practice, emphasizing that supplication is the unparalleled means of drawing near to Allah. The Imam further removes any barrier to supplication by instructing that no need — however trivial it may seem — should be considered too insignificant to bring before Allah, since the Lord of great affairs is equally the Lord of small ones. This teaching was addressed to Sayf al-Tammar, a close companion, reflecting the Imam's practice of imparting spiritual guidance in personal encounters.
word_analysis: by its like / by anything like it

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Abu Najran,  from Sayf Al Tammar who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘It is upon you to supplicate as you will not get closer (to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>) with anything similar to it,
nor should you neglect supplicating for a small (thing) due to its smallness. He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Owner of the small as well as the big (things)’.
en.sarwar: 6. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from ibn abu Najran from Sayf al-Tammar who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘
You must plead before Allah for help; you cannot seek nearness to Allah by any means better than pleading before Him for help.
Do not leave your small needs without pleading before Allah for help, just because they are small; both small and large needs are in the hands of One and the same One.’”
